context: Yumiko and Sho take photos in the park.
purpose: Casual home register; daily vocabulary (カメラ/あたり/周り/コース/タイプ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、このカメラで撮りたい!
lines.en: Mom, I want to shoot with this camera!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわよ。あたりを見回してごらん。
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 周りに、鳥がいっぱいいるよ!
lines.en: There are lots of birds around!
lines.style: delighted small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: この子供向けのタイプは、簡単でしょ?
lines.en: This kids' type is easy, isn't it?
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!どのコースを歩くの?
lines.en: Yeah! Which course do we walk?
lines.style: eager small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 池の周りのコースを、歩きましょう。
lines.en: Let's walk the course around the pond.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あたりが、きらきらしてるね!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: カメラで、周りをたくさん残しましょうね。
lines.en: Let's capture lots of the surroundings with the camera.
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
